mechanism: Combined serotonergic activity from SSRI and irreversible MAOI causes excessive serotonin accumulation, risking serotonin syndrome and potential hypertensive crisis.
action: Contraindicated combination; tranylcypromine must not be initiated within 2 weeks of paroxetine discontinuation, and paroxetine must not be started within 1-2 weeks of tranylcypromine cessation.
